integrator_include.selection: Omit both manual definitions for selector-only Auto. This configuration ignores P1DATA and does not require sources.driver. Define both for the manual configuration. It additionally requires a qualified observed gear, shifting flag and allowed mask in sources.driver. Leave OD unmapped until its source is established.
integrator_include.required_checks: The provider supplies GP−5722.2 as an independently qualified, normalized contact asserted in P/N. The adapter checks agreement with AN2 and refuses a contradiction. The AN2-derived factory flag at 0x806446 does not provide independence.

profile.adc: 2H signal and 2O sensor return. ADC0 AN2, 10-bit raw counts. OEM scale raw × 5/1024 V. Compiled windows use inclusive lower and exclusive upper endpoints with at most one count adjustment from H03 ROM limits.
profile.time_unit: TML0 microseconds on qualified 1 MHz clock
profile.timing_provenance: H03 TOP10 period 0.5 ms times ten releases and a four-observation ROM filter. Age permits less than two nominal observations. Debounce requires four nominal intervals of stable level. Both timings are engineering settings for this bench profile.
profile.reset_and_interlocks: Both profiles reset to Auto with OD enabled. Manual commissioning proposes an adjacent gear only in D, after a debounced mode toggle and new +/− edge, with a valid gear observation, range, allowed mask and no shift in progress. Auto at restart and D-only manual follow docs/decisions.md. Input loss, opposed buttons, mode change, target completion and expiry remove the override. Unqualified commands are withdrawn between Toyota events. OD Off blocks manual fourth requests through the existing Tiptronic policy when a qualified OD map is provided.
profile.h03_p1data: Pinned image 0x040180 projects P1DATA bits 6, 5 and 3 to 0x804AF4, 0x804AF5 and 0x804AF6. The connector-side active voltage is below 1 V. The PCB mapping and whether each input conditioner inverts at the MCU are unresolved.

divider_calculation.model: raw = 1024 × (Vpullup/Vref) × Rselector/(Rselector + Rpullup). Bounds round outwards in ADC counts. Rpullup is an assumed effective DC impedance, not a measured parameter.
divider_calculation.nominal_case: 390 Ω pull-up, ratiometric excitation, 5 V scale
divider_calculation.provenance: The Mazda FS5A-EL vehicle diagram shows the external TR path, not the LFJ8-18-9E1C PCB network. Proposed external 2/L nominal resistors follow S/L references in the Mazda FN4A-EL material and are supported conditionally by H03 ROM ranges and the divider calculation. Earlier project R=1500 Ω has a conservative range [778, 831], six counts below the R window. A new 1%-tolerance 1650 Ω external resistor restores margin under the same assumptions. The FS5A-EL service range 132–390 Ω in D can overlap the added 2 step. Reusing the OEM D contact requires its own value to be identified.

TOY-02/03 must supply qualified load and independent GP−5722[0..3] and GP−5250.2 in the actual provider. The independent P/N contact must be traceable to an input, distinct from the AN2-derived OEM flag. Manual configuration additionally needs independent gear observation, shift state, allowed mask and an evidenced hold limit.

H03-03 must align Toyota release admission with input startup and selector transitions. The current source faults on an unqualified scheduled release. The nominal minimum ready times are 20 ms or 40 ms after boot. The mode simulator uses a 40 ms Toyota event period to exercise this boundary. Do not import that period into S01. With shorter real Toyota cadence, keep physical authority inhibited, apply the release owner's bounded rearm/reanchor on transient acquisition, and preserve S01 cadence and missed-event detection after rearm.

Use the selector-only option while the physical map is unresolved. OD currently limits manual fourth when a qualified source is mapped. A requested OD limit in donor Auto would require a Toyota gear-limit input and an agreed policy before enabling it.
